Situation Update — last 30 minutes

  • No sirens or strikes reported in the last 30 minutes.
  • Tehran — Khamenei farewell: security stepped up. Large state ceremony underway. Checkpoints and increased troop/police presence around major sites.
  • High‑level Russian security official arrived in Tehran. Attending funeral events. Tactical context: foreign security presence may indicate protective coordination or intelligence ties.
  • Seismic event — M4.3, 46 km SW of Ḩājjīābād, depth 10 km. Shallow quake. Could disrupt local security logistics and transport in southern Iran. No casualty reports yet.
  • Domestic mood: reports of some Iranians avoiding the ceremony. Uneven turnout raises risk of protests or isolated security incidents at mass gatherings.
  • Context: Day 27 of US‑Israel operations. Second US pause on Iran energy strikes is active (10 days, deadline Apr 6). Pakistan mediating. Northern border (Hezbollah) remains active daily.
  • Operational note: Large public events plus foreign delegations increase protection needs and may produce temporary airspace/ground restrictions around Tehran.
  • 🟢 Good News: No attacks or sirens in this reporting window.
  • Threat assessment: escalating

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Diplomacy / Pause: US President announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET). White House says talks “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • Tehran: Security & funeral Tehran stepped up security for Khamenei farewell. Mourners laid leader in state; some Iranians avoiding ceremony. Top Russian security official arrived. Tehran plans to close airspace on July 6 for the funeral procession. Tactical: concentrated foreign delegations raise target/high-incident risk.
  • Military posture / messaging Iranian officials (TASS) warn US breaches will trigger response. Flight-scan detected 786–777 commercial aircraft in sector; one military flight (RCH457) logged in recent scans.
  • Arms / proliferation Russia to supply V-200 rotary-wing drones to Far East/Siberia. Indonesia considering expanding BrahMos missile procurement. Tactical: regional missile/drone flows increasing, potential proxy access.
  • Economics / sanctions Reuters: Iran exploring oil sales to Japan; buyers seeking longer sanctions waivers. Tactical: economic openings continuing despite public denials.
  • Seismic M4.3 earthquake 46 km SW of Ḩājjīābād, Iran (depth 10 km). No damage reports yet. Monitor critical infrastructure and bases.
  • Operational note High-profile funeral events + foreign security delegations increase short-term risk to diplomatic/military assets in Tehran.
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause in energy strikes gives a temporary window for de-escalation and limited diplomatic movement.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • טהראן: ביטחון וסדרת לוויות הגברת אבטחה לטקס פרידתו של ח'אמנאי. הניחו ראשי הנפטר להצטדק; חלק מהאזרחים נמנעים מההשתתפות. בכיר ביטחוני רוסי נחת לטקס. טהראן תסגור שטח אווירי ב-6 ביולי לצעדת הלווייה. טקטי: צמצום יעדות זרים מעל ההון מעלה סיכון לאירועים ממוקדים.
  • עמדה צבאית / מסרים גורמים איראנים מזהירים שתפיסה אמריקאית של התחייבויות תעורר תגובה. סריקות טיסות הראו 786–777 כלי תעופה אזרחיים; טיסת צבאית אחת (RCH457) זוהתה.
  • נשק / הפצה רוסיה תספק מל"טים מסוג V-200 למזרח הרחוק/סיביר. אינדונזיה שוקלת הרחבת רכישת טילי BrahMos. טקטי: זרימות מל"טים וטילים באזורים הסמוכים עלולות להגיע לפרוקסים.
  • כלכלה / סנקציות רויטרס: איראן בוחנת מכירת נפט ליפן; קונים מבקשים הארכת פטורי סנקציות. טקטי: ערוצי כלכלה ונפט נפתחים למרות הכחשות פומביות.
  • סייסמי רעידת אדמה M4.3, 46 ק"מ דרום-מערב חאג'יאבאד (עומק 10 ק"מ). אין דיווחי נזק עדיין. לעקוב אחרי תשתיות קריטיות ומתקנים צבאיים.
  • הערה מבצעית טקסי ההלוויה והגעת משלחות זרות מגדילים סיכון קצר-טווח לנכסים דיפלומטיים וצבאיים בטהראן.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הפסקת האש השנייה בצד האנרגיה יוצרת חלון זמני לדיפלומטיה והפחתת לחימה.
  • הערכת מצב: מתהדרגת (Escalating).

  • Economics & Energy

    • Temporary pause announced may lower strike tempo if sustained.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Diplomatic pause: Trump announced a 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes until Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET citing an “Iranian request.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. (Context: first 5-day pause on Mar 23 was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.)
  • Air/sea access: Airports closed across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan. Tehran to close airspace on July 6 for Khamenei funeral. Civil and military flight operations disrupted.
  • Funeral tensions: Iran has stepped up security for Khamenei’s farewell week. Senior Russian security officials arrived in Tehran. Iran warned US/Israel against strikes during the funeral period.
  • Hormuz: Iran allowing passage to select “friendly” states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Oman reportedly reached an arrangement with Iran based on a US MoU.
  • Northern border: Hezbollah active daily. Expect continued rocket/missile harassment and localized exchanges.
  • Strike/retaliation pattern: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iranian proxies and Iran conduct missile/drone strikes against Israel. Pauses have been breached before. High risk of near-term re-escalation.
  • Iran exploring oil sales to Japan; buyers seek longer sanctions waivers. Oil prices remain broadly stable.
  • Security incident: IDF reports killing of Hamas operative who abducted tank officer Daniel Perez.
  • Natural event: M4.3 earthquake 46 km SW of Hajjiabad, Iran (depth 10 km). No major damage reports yet.
  • International moves: Continued military air activity. Russian security visit signals political-military support for Tehran.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF reports elimination of the militant linked to the Perez abduction. Oil market stability reduces immediate economic shock.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

48.en:
Situation Brief — Day 27

  • Active: Ongoing US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran and Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile/rocket counterstrikes on Israel in the last 48 hours.

Topline

  • US President announced 2nd pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days to Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET, said request came from Iran. Iran denies direct talks.
  • First pause (Mar 23, 5 days) was violated hours later when US/Israeli jets struck Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Pakistan is mediating communications between parties.

Northern Border

  • Hezbollah attacks active daily. Frequent rocket/artillery launches and IDF retaliatory strikes reported.
  • Routine escalation pattern — probing strikes followed by targeted IDF responses.

Air & Sea

  • US/Israeli strikes have targeted Iranian facilities inside Iran (Isfahan, Khorramshahr among reported sites).
  • Iran permits Strait of Hormuz passage for select 'friendly' nations (Russia, India, China); others face restrictions.
  • Regional airspace and several airports reported closed in recent flight scans (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan).

Diplomacy & Economics

  • Iran exploring oil sales to Japan; buyers seek longer sanctions waivers.
  • Iran conditions any deal on Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon per Iranian statements.
  • Oil prices remain relatively stable amid pause/mediation noises.

Domestic Iran

  • Khamenei laid in state; security stepped up across Tehran. Iran warns against strikes during funeral events.
  • Tehran plans airspace closures for funeral processions.

International

  • High-level Russian security delegation in Tehran for funeral events.
  • Pakistan acting as intermediary — practical diplomatic channel.

🟢 Good News

  • Temporary US pause announced gives a diplomatic window. Pakistan mediation active. Oil prices stable.

Bottom line

  • Threat assessment: Escalating — exchanges continue, pauses fragile and violations probable.

  • פקיסטן פועלת כערוץ מעשי לתיווך.

🟢 חדשות טובות

  • הפסקת האש הזמנית של ארה"ב יוצרת חלון דיפלומטי. תיווך פקיסטני פעיל. מחירי הנפט לא קופצים.

סיכום

  • הערכת איום: במגמת הסלמה — חילופי תקיפות נמשכים, ההפסקות שבריריות והפרות צפויות.
